messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@cloudbridge.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudBridge launch roadmap & ops intro (marketplace launch roadmap)

Hi Emily / AWS team —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a mutual-action roadmap so we have clear owners, milestones, and a realistic close window for the CloudBridge listing. High-level goals: list in AWS Marketplace, enable private offer flow, and validate a first paid transaction within the quarter.

Attached is an initial MAP workbook with proposed milestones and owners (tabbed by "Redwood", "CloudBridge", "AWS"), plus a short checklist from our marketplace ops playbook. Please review and push any edits to the Drive link below.

Proposed near-term milestones (suggested dates):
- Product artifacts & tech contact confirmed — 2027-03-22 (owner: CloudBridge)
- Listing draft (pricing & SKU) — 2027-03-29 (owner: Redwood + CloudBridge)
- Security evidence + contract redlines submitted — 2027-04-05 (owner: CloudBridge)
- Marketplace listing QA & sandbox test purchase — 2027-04-12 (owner: AWS + Redwood)

Questions / asks for this thread:
1) Emily — please confirm your primary technical lead and legal reviewer for the listing timeline.
2) AWS team — any blackout dates or gating prerequisites we should account for?
3) Marcus / Marissa — can you own the listing draft and the internal rollout comms respectively?

Next step: if this looks good to Emily and AWS, can we lock the owners by EOD Wednesday and have a short 30-min weekly sync starting next Monday 3/22?

Attachments: [attachment: CloudBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [attachment: RBW_Marketplace_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Thanks Vanessa — this is great and much appreciated.

Quick answers:
- Primary tech lead: Tom Alvarez (tom.alvarez@cloudbridge.com) — he will own the integration tests and sandbox validation.
- Legal / procurement reviewer: Priya Natarajan (legal@cloudbridge.com) — she'll take lead on contract redlines and PO cadence.

I've reviewed the MAP workbook and made three small notes in the "CloudBridge" tab (pricing cadence, security evidence owner, and our preferred launch SKU). I uploaded an updated copy to the Drive link you shared.

We can commit to the dates you suggested pending AWS gating items. Weekly sync on Mondays at 10:30am PT works for us — ok to start 3/22.

Forwarding Tom and Priya into this thread for transparency.

--

Hi all —

Thanks for the intro and draft MAP. A few notes from Marketplace Ops perspective:
- Gating items: seller account verification, product AMI/testing artifacts, and private offer legal templates. If any of those are delayed, the listing can slip by 2-3 weeks.
- Preferred test window: we can schedule sandbox QA the week of 4/5; please provide test account credentials and a demo flow.
- Stricter requirement: for private offers we need counter-signed PO + tax forms before enabling live purchases.

I'll add those as "blocking" items in your MAP workbook and put tentative owners on our side (Marketplace Ops). Also attaching the checklist we use for new Sellers — it maps to the dates Vanessa proposed.

Action items we need by 3/24:
1) Seller verification documents (CloudBridge legal)
2) Demo sandbox credentials (CloudBridge tech)
3) Draft listing text & pricing (Redwood + CloudBridge)

cc: Tom Alvarez, Priya Natarajan

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Ops
aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
